newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns details $1.28 bln MYDFA debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns details $1.28 bln MYDFA debt deal.

text.p: Bear Stearns & Co said on Wednesday that it underwrote a $1.28 billion 144A debt offering on behalf of the Dart family.

The Multi-Year Deposit Facility Agreement (MYDFA) trust certificates have a maturity date of September 15, 2007 and were priced at 84.642 to yield 11.245 percent, or 110 basis points over the EI Brady bond, Bear Stearns said.
The issue has a floating rate coupon that consist of libor plus 13/16 and is structured in a way similar to Brazil's EI bonds, the underwriter said.
The deal securitizes all of Brazil's remaining (MYDFA) loans that had not been restructured as Brady bonds.
